name: Corpse Party D2: Depths of Despair
source:
Years ago, on a rainy after-school day, five students were telling ghost stories while preparing for the school culture festival when they were suddenly transported into the cursed Heavenly Host…

By the end of the night, only two remained.

It’s been six years since Ayumi was trapped in Heavenly Host, and her old classmates have invited her to a reunion in their old classroom. However, it isn’t long before Ayumi finds herself in a familiar cursed school.

This time, Ayumi stands alone against the vengeful spirits of Heavenly Host. Her captors seemingly fueled by her guilt, Ayumi’s only chance of survival is to come to terms with what happened six years before…

[From [url=http://jackkel-dragon.tumblr.com/CPD2]Jackkel Dragon's Tumblr[/url]]

The game is based on the Ending D-2 from the original CORPSE-PARTY, also known as the worst ending, where only Ayumi and Naomi manage to survive from the original group of five people.
translation:
多年前，一个下着雨的放学后的日子，五个学生在为学校文化节做准备时讲鬼故事，突然穿越到了被诅咒的天神之中……

到了晚上，只剩下两个人了。

步美被困天主已经六年了，她的老同学邀请她去老教室聚会。然而，没过多久，步美就发现自己身处一所熟悉的被诅咒的学校。

这一次，步美独自对抗天军的复仇之魂。绑架她的人似乎因她的内疚而助长了步美唯一的生存机会，就是接受六年前发生的事情……

[来自[url=http://jackkel-dragon.tumblr.com/CPD2]Jackkel Dragon的Tumblr[/url]]

该游戏基于原版《尸体派对》的结局D-2，也被称为最坏结局，最初的五人小组中只有步美和直美能够生存。
